messages:
sam: kicking off a short thread to lock down the performance initiatives we want in the next quarter. focus: throughput/latency, kernels, quant, KV cache. we need concrete scope by EOD Friday.
kevin: +1. customers pushing hard on p99 for short responses (<=256 tokens). two enterprise pilots require p99 < 200ms for 8k context trimmed to 256.
maya: we should prioritize KV cache TTL and multi-tenant eviction — it gives immediate wins for tail latency on chat workloads.
ora: quant rollout is high ROI but risky: model quality regressions are real. need eval harness and rollback hooks before canary.
jorge: ops asks for clear rollout criteria: canary on dedicated pool, traffic <5% then 25%, metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99, bad-token-rate, gen-failure-rate.
kevin: proposed initiatives (pick top 3): 1) kernel selection + per-model kernel profile; 2) KV cache eviction + hot-prefix caching; 3) quantization pipeline + eval gating.
sam: rank those by impact/cost? i think impact: kv cache > kernels ~ quant, cost: kernels lowest, quant highest. we still need a mix small/medium/large.
maya: agree. kernel work is the quick win that helps both latency and throughput with minimal infra change. kv cache is medium effort with big tail improvements. quant is long but reduces perf cost.
ora: for quant: require automated eval to detect meaning-preserving deltas. suggested thresholds: BLEU-like delta < 0.015 normalized and business-critical prompts pass.
kevin: also need to spec kernel fallback behavior when quantized kernels crash. fallback latency budget: +100ms max, otherwise failover to hosted baseline model.
jorge: add incident runbook changes if fallback triggers. SLO breach path: auto-scale + notify oncall -> if sustained, rollback canary.
infra-bot: perf-harness finished benchmark run on latest master: p50=42ms p95=132ms p99=278ms (256 tokens, a100x4). see /ci/perf/1768001
sam: thanks infra-bot. current p99 is above target so we need a clear plan.
kevin: timeline proposal: weeks 1-2 kernel profiling + quick wins; weeks 3-6 kv cache feature (eviction + hot-prefix); weeks 7-12 quant pipeline + gated canaries.
maya: launch criteria per initiative: kernels: perf bump >=10% p95 or p99, no regressions in generation quality. kv cache: p99 improvement >=20% on chat workloads and no memory blowups. quant: cost reduction >=25% with eval pass and rollback path.
ora: add canary tests: synthetic adversarial prompts + customer prompt sets (sanitized) to validate quality. store diffs in eval dashboard.
kevin: infra tasks: add kernel perf flags to model metadata, enable per-model kernel override in runtime config.
jorge: operational tasks: create canary pool, alerting for p99>target*1.2, histogram retention for 14 days.
sam: owners: kernels -> kevin; kv cache -> maya; quant -> ora. deliverables: design doc + perf target + ETA by next Wed.
maya: i'll own the kv design doc. I'll include a migration plan for existing caches and multi-tenant limits.
kevin: i'll do the kernel profiling doc. quick prototype PR by end of week.
ora: i'll start the quant eval harness and wire up prompt sets. need access to enterprise testprompts from cs.
jorge: ops will prep canary infra and alert rules.
sam: decision: we prioritize kernels + kv cache for Q1 rollout, quant stays Q1-Q2 with gated canary only after eval.
maya: noted. will draft scope and tradeoffs in doc.
kevin: question: do we want to include per-request kernel hints API for advanced users? could help atypical models.
sam: defer to follow-up — out of scope for initial push unless tiny effort.
ora: note re: model quality: add human-in-the-loop signoff for enterprise pilot groups.
infra-bot: reminder: design-doc template at /docs/templates/design.md and canary checklist at /ops/canary-checklist.md
sam: action items summary: kevin, maya, ora docs by Wed; ops canary infra by Fri; cs to share sanitized prompts. meeting Tuesday 10am to ship final scope.
kevin: ack.
maya: ack.
ora: ack.
jorge: ack.
sam: thanks all. we'll publish a short note to product and support once scope is firm. :thumbsup:
